run_blender_to_matting: run the script to convert Blender render outputs into a matting-compatible format with poses.json
run_main_move_frames: run the main function to move camera_0000.png files from frame folders into an rgb_1x directory
run_main_generate_poses: run the main function to parse camera JSON files and generate a poses.json with transform matrices
run_main_compute_fov: run the main function to compute field of view from normalized focal length and write it to poses.json
run_main_cleanup: run the main function to optionally delete source frame folders after processing Blender render outputs
